race.comment: BRILLIANT BULL ANT (1) is better judged on the Bendigo second two back than his Seymour failure, with the return to 1300m no issue on his place record. He should be right there despite a wide gate. MOVE IT (13) debuts for the Anthony & Sam Freedman yard who strike well with their newcomers. Trials have been sound, expecting a solid performance. FOXTROT CHARLIE (2) has been going okay, off a freshen for this having run well at Cranbourne last time out to grab fourth behind Hierarchy who is running in the Derby on Saturday. This suits better. AQUAFY (12) is an Ocean Park gelding who can run well on debut, watch betting.
